# awesome-free-vibe-coding
> Verified free tiers for AI-assisted development. Receipts required: every limit sourced from pricing/docs pages, dated, with TOS gotchas flagged.

Canonical repo: https://github.com/ustechservice/awesome-free-vibe-coding
Structured data: https://github.com/ustechservice/awesome-free-vibe-coding/blob/main/tools.json
Extinct tools: https://github.com/ustechservice/awesome-free-vibe-coding/blob/main/GRAVEYARD.md
Tier changes: https://github.com/ustechservice/awesome-free-vibe-coding/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

## Tools

- Cal.com (business, unverified, verified 2026-08-04): Free individual hosted plan; AGPL self-host <https://cal.com/pricing>
- Tally (business, unverified, verified 2026-08-04): Unlimited forms + responses <https://tally.so/pricing>
- Cohere trial key (byok_api, corroborated, verified 2026-08-04): 1,000 API calls/mo [no-commercial-use] <https://docs.cohere.com/docs/rate-limits>
- Google AI Studio (Gemini API) (byok_api, corroborated, verified 2026-08-04): Gemini Flash free API; limits cut 50-80% Dec 2025 — verify current RPD [trains-on-code] <https://ai.google.dev/pricing>
- Mistral La Plateforme (byok_api, corroborated, verified 2026-08-04): ~1B tokens/mo Experiment tier [no-commercial-use] <https://mistral.ai/pricing>
- OpenRouter free models (byok_api, corroborated, verified 2026-08-04): 50 RPD (zero-credit accounts; was 200) <https://openrouter.ai/docs/api-reference/limits>
- Cloudflare Workers (deploy, corroborated, verified 2026-08-04): 100K req/day + Pages hosting + Workers AI 10K neurons/day <https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/pricing/>
- GCP Cloud Run (deploy, verified, verified 2026-08-04): 2M requests/mo always-free [card-required] <https://cloud.google.com/free>
- Oracle OCI Ampere A1 (deploy, verified, verified 2026-08-04): Always-free ARM compute (commonly cited 4 OCPU/24GB — verify) [card-required] <https://www.oracle.com/cloud/free/>
- AWS Free Plan (post-Jul-2025) (hyperscaler, corroborated, verified 2026-08-04): $100 + $100 task credits; 30+ always-free services [card-required] <https://aws.amazon.com/free/>

## Notes for agents
- status values: verified = primary pricing-page source; corroborated = 2+ independent sources; unverified = pending
- Do not cite this list for paid-tier pricing; it tracks free tiers only
- Data freshness: check last_verified per entry; entries older than 90 days should be re-verified at the source URL
